fields.statement: QA cycle 2, scratch build of 13a633dfe in a hermetic repo (RHIZA_TEST_NOW stand-ins, fake rex): RHIZA_TEST_TMP_FREE_BYTES=1GiB under the 2G default made daemon --once skip the ready change set as tmp-low ('1.0 GiB free in the temp directory, under the minimum of 2.0 GiB'), saved tmp_low in daemon.state.json, wrote a tmp-low queue-wait line and one tmp-low inbox item; 2147483647 bytes held, exactly 2G started; minTmpFree 0 started even at 1 byte and cleared the item and state; daemon set minTmpFree banana and 2Q and --min-tmp-free banana refused as not a size (exit 2)

QA cycle 2, scratch build: inside a live run's fake step session, a memory-low, then tmp-low, then disk-low hold saved by daemon --once made rhiza run spawn wait (killed by timeout after 3s, no child started) and journal exactly one spawn-held entry with role verifier and the reading and limit in its detail; after daemon --once released the hold, the spawn started the child (outcome pass) and its spawn entry released the hold; with no hold saved the spawn journaled no spawn-held entry and its response had no held

QA cycle 2, scratch build: with a memory-low hold saved, rhiza run start --foreground of a one-agent-step workflow journaled one spawn-held entry for the step with no parent and never called the agent (no claude invocation); run resume while still held added no second entry; after the hold was released, resume started the step's session, whose session entry released the hold, and the run succeeded

QA cycle 2, scratch build: a live run's held verifier spawn showed one spawn-held item in rhiza inbox and --json naming change set, title, step, parent session, role and 'machine hold: memory-low: 1.0 GiB available, under the minimum of 2.0 GiB'; rhiza inbox open on it (f1 fix 13a633dfe) focused the run's journalled tab block:qa1 (opened true) when the run had one, and without a tab was refused as usage naming the held session and run; a bogus ID says no inbox item; the item was gone after the spawn started and after the run ended
